lang: python
file: app/assets.py

_BLOB_CACHE = {}

def decode_blob(data):
    cached = _BLOB_CACHE.get(data)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    payload = memoryview(data).tobytes()
    _BLOB_CACHE[data] = payload
    return payload

def handle_job(job):
    pages = []
    for asset in job.assets:
        payload = decode_blob(asset.data)
        pages.append(render_asset(payload))
    return pages
